image_analysis.description: Short description of the page layout.

transcription.description:
Markdown transcription of the catalogue page.
- Lot headings as <lot>...</lot>, prices as <price>...</price>.
- Tables as HTML <table> elements.
- Unreadable words as [illegible].
Null when the page has no text.

no_transcribable_text.description: True when the page holds no text.

transcription_not_possible.description: True when the page cannot be read.
